defects_fixed.observed: measured elapsed ~35ms became 0 at terminal transition
defects_fixed.fix: _disarm now _pauseWait() first: freeze/preserve measured elapsed, no idle accumulation; turnStarted resets for the new turn

nested tool pauses keep clock paused until the innermost resumes
terminal freeze: measured elapsed preserved at turn end, new turn resets
